purpose: Enumerate the exact completed-state columns, Arrow types, row counts, row-group boundaries, timestamp coverage and small head/tail samples before mapping the preregistered semantic feature groups to source columns.
allowed_reads: first and last five rows from each registered state table
row-group statistics and file-level nullability metadata
precommitted_semantic_feature_groups: multi-level stationary queue shape and imbalance
aggressive buy/sell flow and activity intensity
book update, withdrawal and refill intensity
short-horizon realized movement and range compression
post_probe_rule: Choose at most twelve source columns or prior-only transforms that directly instantiate these groups, then freeze one HGBT specification, one fit-score quantile and three structural target/stop cells before any future label, score or PnL is computed.
